bio_metadata.rookie_method: First regular-season entry in official NBA SEASONS; no inference from draft year alone. Missing debut records remain unknown.
bio_metadata.limitations: Retrieved biographies are not archived 2025 pages. Only stable birth/draft facts and season-index history are used; no current scoring, team, age or position imported.

methodology.raw: overall_pick minus historical Yahoo ADP; negative means selected early.
methodology.keeper_adjusted: known-ADP discretionary index minus initial keeper-depleted known-ADP market rank; negative means early. Ties use minimum rank. Unknown-ADP live picks do not advance this known-market clock.
methodology.available_rank: 1 plus number of available alternatives with strictly better Yahoo ADP. All 36 keepers removed before slot 1.
methodology.pool: 200 known-ADP records plus observed missing-ADP selections, not all 1,344 retired/FA records. Historical eligible universe is incomplete.
methodology.adp_gap: Selected ADP minus best available ADP: positive means bypassing better-ADP options. Different sign convention from timing deviations.

validation.method: Forward-by-round holdouts; fixed shrinkage; round-block bootstrap
limitations: One league-season; historical ADP measurement date unknown.
Only known-ADP alternatives are scored; four live picks have missing ADP.
No historical fantasy value/roster-fit coefficients fitted. Exported positions are coarse and not verified historical Yahoo eligibility.
Choice Brier is not survival Brier. Multi-pick survival calibration is not established by this small single-season validation.

survival_replay.method: Forward-round training; every eligible held-out choice anchors next-manager-live-pick forecasts. Fixed available-rank strata; actual current choice known, intervening choices simulated. Horizons crossing missing-ADP live picks censored.
survival_replay.limitations: Few correlated horizons from one season; descriptive calibration, not evidence of transportability to 2026. Undrafted alternatives follow initial known-ADP order; historical eligibility/ADP-date uncertainty remains.
